title: The Perfect Letter
author: Ines Thornbury
blurb: Juniper Villalobos, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, has spent twelve years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
